name: Victor Arana
headline: SRE IV / DevOps / Automation & AI Engineer

comp_targets._note: Vic's real targets are AFTER-TAX (net), set 2026-08-27: baseline 90,000, desired 150,000, USD or EUR treated interchangeably. Job boards (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Adzuna/RemoteOK) only ever disclose GROSS salary, and this codebase has no per-country tax model (US federal+state, Spain's Beckham Law flat 24%, standard EU progressive brackets are all wildly different). min_comp_monthly_usd above is a rough GROSS proxy for the 90k net floor, using a conservative blended ~28% effective tax assumption (90000 / 0.72 / 12 rounded), NOT a real per-country calculation. As of 2026-08-27, 0 of 40 live matches disclose salary at all, so this floor currently has zero practical effect, it only starts filtering once Adzuna/RemoteOK salary data actually flows in. Revisit with real per-country tax modeling if/when comp_disclosed postings become common enough to matter.

track_d_us_sponsor._note: Deliberately no 2-letter state codes (CA/NY/TX/WA), those false-hit constantly inside ordinary words. Location field is short and structured, full state/city names are enough. preferred_states set 2026-08-26 per Vic: Texas (named explicitly) + New England + Upper Midwest + Mountain West, chosen for lower violent crime / higher standard of living over a 30-year horizon. Hard filter: a job pinned to a non-preferred state is excluded even if otherwise remote-tagged. A job with no pinned state at all (generic 'Remote, US') passes if genuinely remote, since the employer isn't dictating a location, that's compatible with living in Texas.
